# Fazeshift

Fazeshift is a Software Development company. Fazeshift is an AI-powered platform that offers an AI-powered platform to automate accounts receivable, invoicing, payment matching, and customer communications. Fazeshift employs 44 people (+388.9% YoY, +35 people). Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Fazeshift is an AI-driven accounts receivable platform designed to help enterprises automate invoicing, cash application, and collections—improving efficiency, reducing errors, and accelerating revenue cycles. 

Big enterprises trust Fazeshift to:
- Automate invoice creation and distribution, eliminating manual processing.
- Enhance collections with AI-powered reminders and predictive payment insights.
- Seamlessly integrate with ERP and accounting systems to ensure accurate reconciliation.

Without automation, businesses struggle with slow payments, revenue leakage, and inefficient AR management. Fazeshift transforms AR from a bottleneck into a growth driver.

Supercharge your cash flow with intelligent automation. Visit www.fazeshift.com.

# Tradeshift

Tradeshift is a Software Development company. Tradeshift is a company that provides e-Invoicing software and accounts payables automation platform. They ensure compliance in 69 countries, including in France and Belgium. Tradeshift employs 339 people (-8.6% YoY, -32 people) and has an annual revenue of $146.8M, founded in 2009. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States, operates in 8 countries (including Japan, United Kingdom, Romania, Malaysia, and Belgium). Its workforce is distributed across 21 countries (including Romania, Malaysia, United Kingdom, United States, and China).

## About

Leading AP automation software | Reduce processing cost by 90% | For large and mid-sized companies | Our customers include DHL, Danone, HSBC, Kuehne + Nagel, and Air France KLM.

Our platform automates accounts payable, e-invoicing, and procurement, generating huge efficiencies and cost savings for buyers and suppliers. 

Advanced AI-driven invoice processing eliminates manual tasks, reducing manual coding by up to 99.5%. 

Last year, we saved customers over 3 million hours of manual work, cutting invoice processing costs tenfold.

Tradeshift ensures e-invoicing compliance in over 70 countries, including China, and is a registered Plateforme Dematerialization Partenaire (PDP) in France. 

Our global compliance-as-a-service capabilities keep you ready for e-invoicing and clearance mandates worldwide.
Our tailored onboarding approach and unique supplier value proposition deliver 80%+ e-invoicing adoption across our customers’ supplier bases. 

The Tradeshift network connects over one million businesses in 190 countries. We add an average of 30,000 new supplier connections each month. 

Recognised as the top Procure to Pay solution by Spend Matters, Tradeshift helps businesses Digitise, Automate, and Grow—delivering tangible value across your digital transformation.

Find out more at: www.Tradeshift.com

properties.description:
Leading AP automation software | Reduce processing cost by 90% | For large and mid-sized companies | Our customers include DHL, Danone, HSBC, Kuehne + Nagel, and Air France KLM.

Our platform automates accounts payable, e-invoicing, and procurement, generating huge efficiencies and cost savings for buyers and suppliers. 

Advanced AI-driven invoice processing eliminates manual tasks, reducing manual coding by up to 99.5%. 

Last year, we saved customers over 3 million hours of manual work, cutting invoice processing costs tenfold.

Tradeshift ensures e-invoicing compliance in over 70 countries, including China, and is a registered Plateforme Dematerialization Partenaire (PDP) in France. 

Our global compliance-as-a-service capabilities keep you ready for e-invoicing and clearance mandates worldwide.
Our tailored onboarding approach and unique supplier value proposition deliver 80%+ e-invoicing adoption across our customers’ supplier bases. 

The Tradeshift network connects over one million businesses in 190 countries. We add an average of 30,000 new supplier connections each month. 

Recognised as the top Procure to Pay solution by Spend Matters, Tradeshift helps businesses Digitise, Automate, and Grow—delivering tangible value across your digital transformation.

Find out more at: www.Tradeshift.com
